# Arafath Backwater Tours & Travels

> Arafath Backwater Tours & Travels specializes in Kerala backwater tours, Alleppey houseboat bookings, scenic backwater cruises, and authentic local boat experiences. We arrange backwater trips, houseboat experiences, and customized backwater tour packages for domestic and international tourists. We also offer Kerala tour packages, Fort Kochi sightseeing tours, Munnar trips, local sightseeing, tourism taxi services, airport transfers, and private transportation. Our goal is to help travelers discover Kerala’s beautiful backwaters, traditional villages, scenic landscapes, and cultural attractions with convenient and personalized travel arrangements.

## Key Destinations
- Fort Kochi (Heritage, Fishing Nets, Art Cafes)
- Vaikom (Village backwaters, Bamboo boat cruise, Coir rope making, Weaving)
- Alleppey / Alappuzha (Houseboat cruises, Vembanad lake)
- Munnar (Hill stations, Tea estates)
- Athirappilly (Waterfalls, Forest trails)
